Title: Next.js: Remote Code Execution in next/og ImageResponse
Description:
The Node.js `ImageResponse` implementation from `next/og` is affected by an upstream vulnerability. This can lead to remote code execution.

Affected applications pass attacker-controlled values into SVG content, attributes, or styles during image generation:

```tsx
import { ImageResponse } from 'next/og'

export async function GET(request: Request) {
const value = new URL(request.url).searchParams.get('value') ?? ''

return new ImageResponse(
<svg width="1200" height="630">
<title>{value}</title>
</svg>
)
}
```

Applications using the Edge `ImageResponse` implementation, or applications that do not pass attacker-controlled values into SVG content, attributes, or styles, are not affected.
NotImpacted: All versions before 16.2.0, all versions starting from 16.3.6
